# Sales Analysis: January to June 2026

## Method

I calculated each order's value as quantity × unit price × (1 − discount %). Net revenue counts only Completed orders.

## q1. Net revenue in March 2026

March has 28 orders. Two don't count: SO-2054 was refunded and SO-2059 was cancelled. The 26 completed orders add up to **£22,869.15**.

For reference, January was £11,034.95 from 19 completed orders, and February was £16,605.20 from 21 completed orders.

## q2. Region with the highest Q2 net revenue

| Region | Q2 net revenue |
|---|---|
| **West** | **£14,194.65** |
| North | £7,861.75 |
| East | £5,564.00 |
| South | £4,759.70 |
| Total | £32,380.10 |

**West** had the highest net revenue in Q2.

**Monitor Arm** grew the most, by **99.1%**.

## q6. Average net order value in Q1

Q1 net revenue was £50,509.30 from 66 completed orders.

£50,509.30 ÷ 66 = **£765.29**
